_not: Sefer hikâye sahneleri ve Harita 1 final sinematiği (oyun içi metin İngilizce; Ömer kararları 2026-10-21, form CprM9eeoVef4RYd2VH52Ro; not: docs/design/campaign/cinematics.md). Her anahtar bir sinematik: trigger = nerede tetiklenir (src/campaign/cinematics.ts > dueCinematic okur; görüldü bilgisi kayıtta done listesinde cinematic:<id>, seferde bir kez; oynatıcı src/ui/cinematic.ts), scenes[] = sırayla gösterilen sahneler; her sahnede bg = arka plan anahtarı (border-road / kings-bridge / ember-road / castle-hall var olan savaş arka planları; cin_* = final sinematiğinin yeni görselleri/klipleri, henüz yok), lines[] = oyuncu dokundukça satır satır ilerleyen satırlar. speaker: narrator (anlatıcı), leader (bölük lideri; adı yok, oyunda sınıf adıyla görünür), ya da portre anahtarı (bridge_warden, lord_morvane = boss id + assets/avatars; merchant = Odo, portresi assets/avatars/merchant). Seçenek / likes YOK. endCard = son kapanış kartı (campaign.json > texts.complete ile aynı metin). Hafif ipucu kuralı: Morvane sırrı açmaz; yalnızca tacın kırılmaması ve korlarının parlaması sezdirilir.

_fallback._not: Eksik sahne görselinin yedeği (arka plan anahtarı -> başka anahtar). Görsel aranma sırası: assets/cinematics/<bg>.webp, sonra assets/backgrounds/<bg>.webp, ikisi de yoksa buradaki yedek (zincir izlenir). Yeni görsel gelince yalnızca dosya eklenir, kod değişmez.

_speakers._not: Konuşan anahtarı -> görünen ad + portre (assets/avatars/<portrait>.webp). Burada olmayan anahtar: narrator = portresiz, adsız; leader = bölük liderinin sınıf adı + sınıf avatarı; diğerleri boss / mob id (görünen adı ve avatarı oyun verisinden).

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For a year now, grey ash has fallen over Valdoria.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It drifts south from Castle Morvane in the north, and each day the Ash Curse swallows a little more of the land.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Fields wither, the dead stir in their graves, and men in ash masks sing praise to the Ash Lord.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your road begins on Mill Road, on the western coast. It ends at Morvane's gate.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The last chain snaps. The Bridge Warden sinks to the stones, and the ember in its chest burns low.

lines.speaker: bridge_warden
lines.text: None shall cross... until the king returns. Has he come? Has the king come home?

lines.speaker: leader
lines.text: No one is coming. Your watch is over, Warden.

lines.speaker: bridge_warden
lines.text: Over... Then go north. The Ember in me always leaned toward the crown.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Its light goes out. What is left of King's Bridge still holds, and the road north lies open.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Below the heights, a few tents huddle around one stubborn fire. A familiar cart stands beside it.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Still breathing, friend? Good. The dead make poor customers.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Deserters came down from the gate last week. They swear the halls are thick with ash, and Morvane's crown never stops burning.

lines.speaker: leader
lines.text: Then we will need your best, Odo.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Last stall before the castle, so the prices are honest. Well, honest enough.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ash drifts through the great hall like snow. Beneath a crown of burning iron, Lord Morvane rises from his throne.

lines.speaker: lord_morvane
lines.text: You have come a long way through the ash to reach my hall. Few walk so far only to die.

lines.speaker: leader
lines.text: We came to end the Ash Curse.

lines.speaker: lord_morvane
lines.text: Everything in Valdoria kneels to the ash in the end. So will you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The last blow lands. Lord Morvane sinks to one knee, and the ash in the hall hangs still.

lines.speaker: lord_morvane
lines.text: So it ends with strangers. I always thought it would.

lines.speaker: leader
lines.text: Your curse ends with you, Morvane.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Lord Morvane falls silent. The Crown of Ash rolls across the stones. It does not break. Its embers still glow.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Across Valdoria the grey ash stops falling. For the first time in a year, the wind smells of rain.

morvane_falls.endCard: The Ash Curse is broken. Valdoria is free again.
